## IT'S YOUR TURN TO CLOCK IN!

## IT'S YOUR TURN TO CLOCK IN!

## Want to attend the 2026 NFL Draft in style?

## Want to attend the 2026 NFL Draft in style?  
Head to the official countdown clock on the Great Lawn outside of Acrisure Stadium and "clock in."  
Follow the steps below to be entered into a giveaway for a **VIP 2026 NFL Draft Bundle** , complete with tickets to exclusive events happening during the Draft, merch, and leisure tickets designed to help you explore Pittsburgh beyond the Draft.  
### How to enter for a chance to be our Featured Fan and win a VIP 2026 NFL Draft Bundle:  
📸 Take a photo or video with the clock - the more creative, the better!  
📱 Post your photos and videos on social media with the hashtag #2026NFLDraft (don't forget to tag us and the Steelers!)  
📣 Say or caption: "I'm clocking in! Your turn!"  
🧑🤝🧑 Nominate three friends to do the same!  
Everyone who posts has the chance to be our monthly Featured Fan, and all Featured Fans will receive a swag bag, guaranteed to jumpstart your excitement for the NFL Draft in the Steel City.  
Be a Featured Fan!

## Welcome to Pittsburgh

## Welcome to Pittsburgh  
A city where mighty bridges stand for strength, progress and innovation. Where three rivers meet in a golden triangle forging a proud legacy of tenacity, grit and determination. Steel City. The City of Champions. Birthplace of Legends. Powered by heart and soul, Pittsburgh is a place where football is not just a sport, it's a way of life. It's the perfect place to host the NFL Draft.

## See you in the city where champions are born, see you in Pittsburgh on April 23-25, 2026!
